title: Renewal in Christ
english: Having cried out through the voice of the holy ones, it will be said to those who serve me: 'A new name will be given, which will be blessed on earth, and they will bless the true God.'

For since it has been determined that something new has been done in Christ, let us put aside the oldness that exists and consider what kind of renewal might occur for the better, as if from the fact that not everything was perfectly preserved, but from the corrupted and unexpectedly introduced, in other words from the corrupted.

For if someone were to ask how and from where we will hear this wise and excellent truth, 'Who has known the mind of the Lord?' or 'Who has been his counselor?', it would be clear that they would need both mind and understanding, according to the concept in God.

The skilled artisan God, with his own power and through his Son, created all things and called them into being, though not having ever been, for he made all things through him, and without him nothing was made that was made.
And if someone were to choose to learn these things, it would be necessary for them to have both mind and understanding, according to the concept in God.
